request.prompt: How tall is the Unitree G1?

result.text:
The

Unitree G1

humanoid robot stands approximately 1.32 meters (about 4.3 feet) tall when standing upright.

Key Dimensions & Specifications

Height: ~1.32 m (4.3 ft)

Width: ~45 cm (17.7 in)

Depth: ~20 cm (7.9 in)

Weight: ~35 kg (77 lbs) with battery

Degrees of Freedom (DoF): 23 DoF on the standard version (up to 43 DoF on certain G1 EDU configurations)

Would you like to know more about the Unitree G1's capabilities, battery life, or pricing/availability?
